name: @aether/service-agentic-commerce
description: Signed delegations for AI agents buying on users' behalf: scoped authority (browse/cart/purchase/replenish), cryptographic delegation signing + verification, spend guardrails (per-action/per-day caps, item caps, forbidden categories), human-confirmation thresholds, revocable TTL, consent-gated by constitutional policy. All guardrails are pack data.
